title_en: Wujiang Jiafan Textile Co., Ltd. v. Zhou Fukun — dispute over work-related injury insurance benefits
ruling_gist_en: For workers who suffer personal injury due to a third party's tort and such injury constitutes a work-related injury, during the period of suspension of work with pay retention, the original wages and benefits remain unchanged and shall be paid monthly by the employing entity. If the employer argues that it need not pay wages during the suspension period on the ground that the tortfeasor has already compensated the worker for lost work time, the people's court will not support such argument.
keywords_en: civil; dispute over work-related injury insurance benefits; second instance; intermediate people's court; Jiangsu Province; legal person; natural person; Regulations on Work-Related Injury Insurance; whether wages during suspension of work with pay retention and compensation for lost work time can be concurrently obtained; affirm the original judgment; traffic accident; work-related injury determination; suspension of work with pay retention; arbitration; work-related injury; lawsuit against Zhou Fukun for dispute over work-related injury insurance benefits
full_text_en:
Wujiang Jiafan Textile Co., Ltd. v. Zhou Fukun — dispute over work-related injury insurance benefits

[Ruling Summary]

Where a worker suffers personal injury due to a third party's tort and the injury is also determined to be a work-related injury, the worker's original wage and welfare benefits shall remain unchanged during the period of suspended work pending medical treatment and shall be paid monthly by the employer. Where the employer asserts that it is not required to pay wages for the period of suspended work on the ground that the tortfeasor has already compensated the worker for lost work time, the people's court shall not support such assertion.

Plaintiff: Wujiang Jiafan Textile Co., Ltd., domiciled at: East Zone of Miaogang Industrial Area, Qidu Town, Wujiang District, Suzhou City, Jiangsu Province.

Legal Representative: Qian Chuanda, Director of the Company.

Defendant: Zhou Fukun, male, born on June 11, 1987, Han nationality, domiciled in Yanjin County, Zhaotong City, Yunnan Province.

The plaintiff, Wujiang Jiafan Textile Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as Jiafan Company), filed a lawsuit with the Wujiang District People's Court of Suzhou City due to a dispute over work-related injury insurance benefits with the defendant, Zhou Fukun.

Plaintiff's Allegations: The arbitration award made by the Labor Personnel Dispute Arbitration Commission of Wujiang District, Suzhou City, seriously deviates from the facts and contradicts the legislative intent. The defendant, Zhou Fukun, sustained a work-related injury due to a traffic accident on his way to work. Whether it is the compensation for lost work time in the traffic accident or the wages for the period of suspended work pending medical treatment under work-related injury benefits, both are payments for the actual reduction in income caused by the defendant's need to rest due to the injury from this traffic accident and inability to work. Therefore, regardless of the different names, for the same injury, the compensation for lost work time has already been recovered in the traffic accident compensation, and awarding wages for the period of suspended work pending medical treatment again under work-related injury benefits clearly contradicts the legislative intent of the principle against duplicate compensation. Hence, the plaintiff disagreed with the arbitration award and filed this lawsuit, requesting the court to rule: 1. That the plaintiff is not required to pay the defendant wages for the period of suspended work pending medical treatment in the amount of RMB 7,028; 2. That the defendant bear the litigation costs of this case.

Defendant's Defense: The arbitration procedure was lawful, and the arbitration award applied the law correctly. The defendant requested the court to render a judgment according to law.

Facts Found by the Wujiang District People's Court of Suzhou City at First Instance:

On April 19, 2019, the defendant, Zhou Fukun, applied for arbitration to the Labor Personnel Dispute Arbitration Commission of Wujiang District, Suzhou City (hereinafter referred to as the Arbitration Commission), requesting that the plaintiff, Jiafan Company, pay him a lump-sum disability subsidy of RMB 30,571.8, a lump-sum medical subsidy of RMB 30,000, a lump-sum employment subsidy of RMB 15,000, medical expenses of RMB 239.4, and wages for the period of suspended work pending medical treatment of RMB 7,028. During the arbitration hearing on May 14, 2019, Zhou Fukun increased his claims, requesting to terminate the labor relationship with Jiafan Company from the date of application for arbitration. On May 21, 2019, the Arbitration Commission ruled that the labor relationship between Zhou Fukun and Jiafan Company was terminated on April 19, 2019, and that Jiafan Company pay Zhou Fukun a lump-sum employment disability subsidy of RMB 15,000 and wages for the period of suspended work pending medical treatment of RMB 7,028, totaling RMB 22,028, and dismissed Zhou Fukun's other arbitration claims. Jiafan Company filed a lawsuit with the court of first instance within the statutory period.

The defendant, Zhou Fukun, started working for the plaintiff, Jiafan Company, in October 2015, and Jiafan Company paid social insurance premiums for Zhou Fukun. On July 9, 2018, Zhou Fukun, while driving an ordinary two-wheeled motorcycle on his way home from work, collided with an electric bicycle driven by Zhang Lingmei, resulting in damage to both vehicles and injuries to Zhou Fukun and Zhang Lingmei. On July 10, 2018, the Traffic Police Brigade of the Public Security Bureau of Wujiang District, Suzhou City, issued an accident determination letter, finding Zhang Lingmei primarily responsible and Zhou Fukun secondarily responsible. Zhou Fukun's injuries were diagnosed by the Fourth People's Hospital of Wujiang District on July 9, 2018, as head and facial trauma and multiple contusions. Zhou Fukun was hospitalized at the Fourth People's Hospital of Wujiang District from July 10 to July 16, 2018. Thereafter, Zhou Fukun visited the same hospital twice for outpatient treatment and paid medical expenses of RMB 239.4. On July 16, July 30, and August 14, 2018, the Fourth People's Hospital of Wujiang District issued medical leave certificates for Zhou Fukun stating "rest for two weeks," "rest for two weeks," and "rest for one week," respectively.

On July 31, 2018, through mediation by the traffic police department, the defendant, Zhou Fukun, and Zhang Lingmei reached an agreement: Zhou Fukun would bear Zhang Lingmei's medical expenses of RMB 600 and lost work time compensation of RMB 1,900; for Zhou Fukun's medical expenses of RMB 8,000, Zhang Lingmei would bear RMB 4,800, and Zhou Fukun would bear RMB 3,200; in addition, Zhang Lingmei would compensate Zhou Fukun a total of RMB 3,800 for lost work time, nutrition, etc.

On October 30, 2018, the Human Resources and Social Security Bureau of Wujiang District, Suzhou City, issued Determination of Work-Related Injury No. Su Wujiang Ren She Gong Ren Zi [2018] 3041, determining that the injury suffered by Zhou Fukun constituted a work-related injury. On February 20, 2019, the Labor Ability Appraisal Committee of Suzhou City issued Notification of Conclusion of Labor Ability Appraisal No. Su Wujiang Gong Chu [2019] 92, confirming that Zhou Fukun's disability level corresponded to Grade 10.

During the first-instance trial, the plaintiff, Jiafan Company, stated: The defendant, Zhou Fukun's, average wage in the year before the injury was RMB 5,000 per month, paid by Jiafan Company via bank card deposit. Zhou Fukun stated: His average wage in the year before the injury was RMB 8,000 per month, paid by Jiafan Company via bank card deposit.

Opinion of the Wujiang District People's Court of Suzhou City at First Instance:

After the implementation of the Regulations on Work-Related Injury Insurance, if a worker suffers an injury due to an accident at work and it is determined to be a work-related injury, the worker shall be entitled to corresponding work-related injury insurance benefits in accordance with the Regulations on Work-Related Injury Insurance. The defendant, Zhou Fukun, during the arbitration hearing on May 14, 2019, requested to terminate the labor relationship with the plaintiff, Jiafan Company; therefore, the labor relationship between the parties was terminated on May 14, 2019. Since Jiafan Company had already paid social insurance premiums for Zhou Fukun, the relevant work-related injury insurance benefit items shall be compensated to Zhou Fukun by the work-related injury insurance fund and Jiafan Company respectively, with medical expenses, the lump-sum disability subsidy, and the lump-sum medical subsidy for work-related injuries payable by the work-related injury insurance fund.

Regarding the lump-sum employment disability subsidy claimed by the defendant, Zhou Fukun, the court of first instance held that, according to Article 37 of the Regulations on Work-Related Injury Insurance, Zhou Fukun was assessed as having a Grade 10 disability. Since Zhou Fukun initiated the termination of the labor relationship with the plaintiff, Jiafan Company, Jiafan Company should pay Zhou Fukun a lump-sum employment disability subsidy of RMB 15,000. Furthermore, according to the law, where a worker needs to suspend work to receive medical treatment for work-related injuries, his original wage and welfare benefits shall remain unchanged during the period of suspended work, and the employer shall pay them monthly. The wages for the period of suspended work pending medical treatment shall be determined based on the medical leave certificate issued by the medical institution that has signed a service agreement with the injured worker. Wages for the period of suspended work and compensation for lost work time arise from different legal relationships, and the injured party may receive both. Therefore, the court of first instance did not accept the relevant assertions of Jiafan Company. After Zhou Fukun's injury, the medical institution issued medical leave certificates totaling 35 days of rest. Therefore, the court of first instance determined the period of suspended work to be 35 days. Regarding the wage standard for the period of suspended work, since neither party submitted evidence to prove Zhou Fukun's wage standard, the arbitration award held that Jiafan Company should submit materials such as attendance records and wage calculation standards for verification, but Jiafan Company failed to do so and should bear the adverse consequences. The award further found that Zhou Fukun's pre-injury monthly wage was RMB 8,000, which was within a reasonable range, and accordingly determined the wages for the period of suspended work to be RMB 7,028, which was within the statutory scope. The court of first instance considered that the arbitration award was not improper and therefore supported it.

In summary, the Wujiang District People's Court of Suzhou City, in accordance with Articles 30, 33, 37, and 64 of the Regulations on Work-Related Injury Insurance, and Article 64 of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, rendered the following judgment on August 5, 2019:

1. The labor relationship between Wujiang Jiafan Textile Co., Ltd. and Zhou Fukun was terminated on May 14, 2019.

2. Wujiang Jiafan Textile Co., Ltd. shall, within ten days from the effective date of this judgment, pay Zhou Fukun wages for the period of suspended work pending medical treatment in the amount of RMB 7,028 and a lump-sum employment disability subsidy in the amount of RMB 15,000, totaling RMB 22,028.

3. Wujiang Jiafan Textile Co., Ltd. is not required to pay Zhou Fukun medical expenses, a lump-sum disability subsidy, or a lump-sum medical subsidy for work-related injuries.

After the first-instance judgment was pronounced, Jiafan Company, dissatisfied with the judgment, appealed to the Suzhou Intermediate People's Court of Jiangsu Province.

Appellant's Allegations: The work-related injury in this case resulted from a traffic accident suffered by the appellee, Zhou Fukun, on his way to work. Whether it is the compensation for lost work time in the traffic accident or the wages for the period of suspended work in the work-related injury context, both are payments for the actual reduction in income caused by the appellee's inability to work due to the injury from this traffic accident. Since the compensation for lost work time has already been recovered in the traffic accident compensation, the wages for the period of suspended work should no longer be awarded. The appellant requested the revocation of the original judgment and a new judgment according to law.

The appellee, Zhou Fukun, did not submit a defense.

After the second-instance trial, the Suzhou Intermediate People's Court of Jiangsu Province confirmed the facts found at first instance.

Opinion of the Suzhou Intermediate People's Court of Jiangsu Province at Second Instance:

A worker who suffers an injury due to an accident at work and undergoes treatment is entitled to work-related injury medical treatment benefits. In this case, the appellee, Zhou Fukun, suffered a work-related injury and is entitled to corresponding work-related injury benefits. Since Jiafan Company had paid social insurance premiums for Zhou Fukun, the lump-sum disability subsidy and lump-sum medical subsidy for work-related injuries that Zhou Fukun is entitled to shall be paid by the work-related injury insurance fund.

Regarding the lump-sum employment disability subsidy: The appellee, Zhou Fukun, had a Grade 10 disability, and the appellant, Jiafan Company, should pay Zhou Fukun a lump-sum employment disability subsidy of RMB 15,000.

Regarding the wages for the period of suspended work pending medical treatment: Zhou Fukun rested for 35 days due to the work-related injury, which should be treated as if he had normally provided labor, and he is entitled to wages. The court of first instance's discretionary determination that Jiafan Company pay Zhou Fukun RMB 7,028 as wages for the period of suspended work was not improper.

Regarding Jiafan Company's argument that Zhou Fukun's work-related injury resulted from a third party's tort and that he has already received compensation for lost work time, and therefore cannot simultaneously receive wages for the period of suspended work: The court held that, on one hand, current law does not prohibit a worker from simultaneously receiving work-related injury insurance benefits and compensation for personal injury. On the other hand, work-related injury insurance benefits and civil tort compensation are of different natures; the former belongs to the realm of public law, arising from social insurance legal relationships, while the latter belongs to the realm of private law, arising from civil legal relationships, and they should not be simply substituted for one another.

In conclusion, the first-instance judgment had clear facts and correctly applied the law, and should be upheld. The Suzhou Intermediate People's Court of Jiangsu Province, in accordance with Item (1) of Paragraph 1 of Article 170 of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, rendered the following judgment on December 13, 2019:

Appeal dismissed; original judgment affirmed.

This judgment is final.
